This '''Sith-Imperial walker''' was a bipedal vehicle used by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==Description==
This [[Walker/Legends|walker]] model was armed with two cannons, situated on either side of the cockpit. Its "head" sloped backwards, similar to the [[All Terrain Advance Raider|AT-AR]].

==History==
At least two of these walkers were used by the Imperial Army and participated in the ground assault on the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]] in [[138 ABY]]. There they supported [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] in a role similar to the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] over a [[Standard century/Legends|century earlier]].
